# Critter Quest

> Free math and reading practice app for kindergarten and 3rd grade students. Kids earn coins and collectible critter cards by answering questions correctly. No account or signup required.

## What is Critter Quest?

Critter Quest is a free, browser-based educational app for elementary school children (ages 5–9). It covers math and reading skills aligned with kindergarten and 3rd grade curricula. Children practice by completing quests (10-question sessions) and are rewarded with virtual coins and collectible critter cards, making learning feel like a game.

## Who is it for?

- Kindergarten students (ages 5–6): addition with sums up to 10, subtraction with non-negative differences, sight words, letter sounds, word building (CVC words)
- 3rd grade students (ages 8–9): addition up to 500, subtraction up to 999, multiplication (1–12 times tables), division (whole number quotients), vocabulary, spelling, grammar
- Parents looking for free at-home math and reading reinforcement
- Teachers seeking a no-signup classroom supplement

## Key Features

- Free to use — no account, no subscription, no ads
- Works in any browser — no app download required
- Step-by-step scaffolded math problems guide kids through the thinking process
- Reading quests cover sight words, letter sounds, vocabulary, spelling, and grammar
- Kids earn coins for correct answers and collectible critter cards at the end of each session
- 5 animal themes: forest, ocean, farm, jungle, arctic
- Parent controls: store editor, PIN protection, reward management
- Supports multiple child profiles on one device (family-friendly)
- Built for West Ada School District curriculum (Ada County, Idaho) but usable anywhere

## Subjects Covered

- Math: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, mixed operations
- Reading: sight words (Dolch list), letter sounds, CVC word building, vocabulary, spelling, grammar
